lines.0: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket ke score jaise 1 se 9 aur zero likhenge. Tumhara favourite cricket shot kaunsa hai?

lines.2: Haan, cricket mein runs 1 se 6 tak ho sakte hain; ab screen par 3 collections gino—kitne objects hain?
lines.3: Pehle ka 2, doosre ka 5, teesre ka… continue karo.
lines.4: Pehle, doosre, teesre—likhte jao.
lines.5: Bilkul: 2, 5, 0. Zero ka matlab kuch bhi nahi; ab 3 birds ud jaayen, kaunsa numeral bachega?
lines.6: Haan, zero bilkul sahi—jab kuch bhi nahi hota. Ab naya number-game shuru karte hain. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.7: Aarav, mujhe poori baat sunai nahi di. Tum phir se bolo ya apni baat poori karo. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.8: Aarav, is baar 3 the, phir ek-ek karke flies away. Tumne har fly ke baad kitne bache, woh ginne hain. Ab aage kya karenge? Another flies away: ___ is left.
lines.9: Ab tumne bataya: kuch bhi na bache, toh zero likhte hain. Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.10: Aarav, chanda nahi, yahan taaliyan ginni hain. Har taali par ek count bolo: one, two, three… Taali, taali, taali, taali. Yeh kaun sa number hua?
lines.11: Aarav, tumhe kaise pata chala ki yeh chaar hai?
lines.12: Bilkul, tumne chaar taaliyan gin kar chaar bataya. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.13: Koi baat nahi. Pehle ek poori hand dikhao, phir uske baad wali ungliyan ginne ke liye haath taiyaar rakho. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.
lines.14: Haan, finger par ginna theek hai. Ek haath ki paanch ungliyan gino, phir doosre haath se teen ungliyan gino. Main bolti hoon "eight". Ungliyon se 8 dikhao.

lines.0: Namaste Vihaan beta, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher. Aaj 100 banana aur number line par cricket jaise jumps karenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

lines.2: Bilkul, 94 mein 6 jodne se 100 banta hai. Ab 30 ka partner socho—100 banane ke liye kitne?

lines.0: Namaste Rudra! Main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj products ke patterns dekhenge. Maths mein aapko kaunsa part interesting lagta hai?
lines.1: Rudra, space aur planets wala part yaad rakhenge; ant mein usse jodenge. Pehle: ek din mein seconds ka estimate aap kaise karenge?
lines.2: Aage badhiye, Rudra—ab minutes ko seconds mein badalne wala step bataiye.
lines.3: Bilkul—60 times 60 se 3600 seconds mile. Ab 24 times 3600 ko round karke estimate karne ka pehla step kya hoga?
lines.4: Aapki rounding wali soch aage badhaiye, Rudra.
lines.5: Nahin, Rudra—main aapki AI teacher hoon. Products mein zeros alag karna numbers ko mini-rocket jaisa banata hai: 24 times 3600 mein pehla step?
lines.6: 24 ko 20 aur 3600 ko 3000 round karke, ab 20 times 3000 ka estimate nikaaliye.
lines.7: Nahin, Rudra—main aapki AI teacher hoon. Chaliye, bade products mein zeros ko alag rakhkar calculation kaafi aasaan ho jaati hai. 60 × 700 nikaaliye.
lines.8: 42 ke saath teen zeros kyun judte hain, Rudra—apni soch se samjhaiye.
lines.9: Bilkul, Rudra—60 mein ek aur 700 mein do zeros, isliye 42 ke baad teen zeros: 42,000. Ab 80 times 500 try kijiye.
lines.10: Rudra, aapne zeros sahi gine, par 8 times 5, 40 hota hai; isliye 40 ke baad teen zeros lagaakar 40,000. 500 × 60 kitna hai?
lines.11: Rudra, 500 mein do aur 60 mein ek zero: 5 times 6 equals 30, phir teen zeros—30,000. 600 times 50 nikaaliye.
lines.12: Aapki zero-ginti theek hai; ab card par diye gaye naye product mein pehle non-zero numbers multiply kijiye. 3,000 × 400 nikaaliye.
lines.13: Rudra, 3 times 4 equals 12, aur teen plus do zeros milaakar paanch zeros lagte hain. “Million” bolne se pehle digits giniye. 3,000 × 400 nikaaliye.
lines.14: 12 ke baad paanch zeros bataiye, phir number ko daahine se teen-teen digits ke groups mein padhiye. 3,000 × 400 nikaaliye.
